description: Na₆Ca₃U₂O₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.73 Å.
